channel.title: Velociraptor Artifact Reference
channel.description: Recent content in Artifact Reference on Velociraptor - Digging deeper!

item.title: ADX.Flows.Upload
item.description: This server-side event monitoring artifact waits for new artifacts to be collected from endpoints and automatically uploads those to an Azure Data Explorer (ADX) cluster.

item.title: Admin.Client.Remove
item.description: Purges inactive clients based on a configurable age threshold.

item.title: Admin.Client.Uninstall
item.description: Executes uninstall commands via msiexec, dpkg, or rpm to remove the client from the endpoint.

item.title: Admin.Client.UpdateClientConfig
item.description: Replaces client configuration and optionally rekeys the client ID.

item.title: Admin.Client.Upgrade.Debian
item.description: Upgrades Velociraptor clients on Debian hosts by installing a new Debian package.

item.title: Admin.Client.Upgrade.RedHat
item.description: Upgrades Velociraptor clients on Red Hat hosts by installing a new RPM package

item.title: Admin.Client.Upgrade.Windows
item.description: Upgrades Velociraptor clients on Windows hosts by running msiexec with the provided MSI.

item.title: Azure.Monitor.Upload
item.description: This server-side event monitoring artifact waits for new artifacts to be collected from endpoints and automatically uploads those to an Azure Log Analytics workspace using the **Azure Monitor Logs Ingestion API** (the modern Data Collection Rule based API).

item.title: Demo.Plugins.Fifo
item.description: Demonstrates using the fifo() plugin to detect event sequences, using failed logon attempts preceding a successful logon as a concrete example.

item.title: Demo.Plugins.GUI
item.description: Provides test cases for GUI elements, parameter validation, and notebook rendering.

item.title: Elastic.EventLogs.Sysmon
item.description: Converts Windows Sysmon event logs to ECS schema-compliant output for Elasticsearch ingestion.

item.title: Elastic.Events.Clients
item.description: Forwards real-time monitoring events from selected artifacts to an Elasticsearch index.

item.title: Elastic.Events.Upload
item.description: Forwards real-time monitoring events from selected artifacts to an Elasticsearch index.

item.title: Elastic.Flows.Upload
item.description: Uploads collected artifact results to an Elasticsearch server.

item.title: Generic.Applications.Chrome.SessionStorage
item.description: Extracts key-value session storage entries from Chrome, Brave, and Edge browsers.

item.title: Generic.Applications.Office.Keywords
item.description: Scans Microsoft Office and LibraOffice/OpenDocument files for keyword matches using YARA rules via the `zip` accessor.

item.title: Generic.Client.CleanupTemp
item.description: Removes old temporary files from the Velociraptor client's temp directory.

item.title: Generic.Client.DiskSpace
item.description: Reports disk usage and free disk space on Linux, macOS, and Windows using platform-specific commands.

item.title: Generic.Client.DiskUsage
item.description: Computes disk usage per directory recursively, similar to the `du` command.

item.title: Generic.Client.Info
item.description: Collects basic system details including hostname, OS version, interfaces, and platform info

item.title: Generic.Client.LocalLogs
item.description: Writes client logs to an encrypted local container file with configurable row limit (with flush) and size limit.

item.title: Generic.Client.LocalLogsRetrieve
item.description: Fetches encrypted local log files from endpoints via the upload function.

item.title: Generic.Client.Profile
item.description: Collects runtime profiling data including goroutines, memory, CPU, and metrics from the client.

item.title: Generic.Client.Rekey
item.description: Forces the client to regenerate its client ID and restart itself.

item.title: Generic.Client.Stats
item.description: Records CPU and memory statistics for the Velociraptor client process.

item.title: Generic.Client.Trace
item.description: Captures runtime trace information from the client at a specified interval

item.title: Generic.Client.VQL
item.description: Runs an arbitrary VQL query on the endpoint.

item.title: Generic.Collectors.File
item.description: Searches a filesystem using a set of glob patterns and uploads matching files to the server.

item.title: Generic.Detection.HashHunter
item.description: Searches the filesystem for a list of hashes, with path file size and date filtering.

item.title: Generic.Detection.Logs
item.description: Searches text-based log files for strings matching a regex pattern across common web server and system log paths.

item.title: Generic.Detection.Yara.Glob
item.description: Runs YARA rules against files discovered via glob search with configurable filters and optional upload of hit context.

item.title: Generic.Detection.Yara.Zip
item.description: Searches for YARA matches inside nested compressed archives up to a configurable recursion depth.

item.title: Generic.Forensic.Carving.URLs
item.description: Extracts URLs from files in common user-related locations using regex carving.

item.title: Generic.Forensic.HashLookup
item.description: Collects file hashes from various sources into a central event stream for external lookups.

item.title: Generic.Forensic.LocalHashes.Glob
item.description: Calculates hashes for files matching a glob pattern and stores them in a SQLite database on the client.

item.title: Generic.Forensic.LocalHashes.Init
item.description: Sets up a client-side SQLite database for storing file paths, MD5 hashes, and timestamps generated by `Generic.Forensic.LocalHashes.Glob` or similar artifacts.

item.title: Generic.Forensic.LocalHashes.Query
item.description: Searches the local SQLite hash database for files matching a user-supplied hash list.

item.title: Generic.Forensic.Timeline
item.description: Creates a bodyfile-format timeline of files matching a glob pattern.

item.title: Generic.Network.InterfaceAddresses
item.description: Collects interface addresses and metadata such as MAC, MTU, and IP masks across operating systems.

item.title: Generic.System.EfiSignatures
item.description: Collects UEFI Secure Boot signature variables including PK, db, and dbx from the client.

item.title: Generic.System.HostsFile
item.description: Parses the system hosts file to extract hostname-to-IP mappings.

item.title: Generic.System.ProcessSiblings
item.description: Lists sibling processes from the process tracker to reveal related process activity.

item.title: Generic.System.Pstree
item.description: Shows process lineage by following parent PIDs to establish call chains.

item.title: Generic.Utils.Crypto
item.description: A utility artifact that provides HMAC-SHA256 and other custom hash functions.

item.title: Generic.Utils.DeadDiskRemapping
item.description: Inspects a disk image and produces an appropriate YAML remapping config for transparent filesystem access.

item.title: Generic.Utils.FetchBinary
item.description: A utility artifact which fetches a binary (or data file) from a URL and caches it on disk.

item.title: Generic.Utils.SendEmail
item.description: A Utility artifact for sending emails.

Removes old or unwanted flows from the server based on configurable filters with a dry-run mode.
Sometimes the Velociraptor server accumulates a lot of data that is no longer needed. This artifact will enumerate all flows from all clients and matches them against some criteria. Flows that match are then removed.
